pitches.subject: Brass hurricane lanterns from Moradabad for Online Lighting
pitches.body:
Dear Online Lighting team,

I came across your Searchlight 576RU Oil Lantern Pendant and your Discovery Lighting range, and thought our work might suit your customers. We make brass hurricane lanterns in an antique gold finish in Moradabad, India.

Under the India-UK CETA, these lanterns enter the UK at zero import duty, with proof of origin supplied. Our minimum order is 200 pieces, and our quote range is £7.73–£13.92 FOB per piece.

We use a heavier metal gauge, stated on the spec sheet, so the lanterns feel solid rather than tinny. We also secure the glass with clips and silicone and QC-test every door and latch before packing.

Would you like a catalogue and spec sheet, or a few samples to handle yourselves? I'd be glad to send either.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company]
Moradabad

pitches.subject: Antique brass lanterns for Electricpoint trade customers
pitches.body:
Dear Electricpoint team,

I noticed you list the Searchlight Lantern Antique Brass Glass Domed 1 Light alongside your trade-priced ranges. We manufacture brass hurricane lanterns in an antique gold finish in Moradabad, India, and would like to offer you a direct supply option.

These lanterns enter the UK at zero import duty under the India-UK CETA, with proof of origin provided. Our MOQ is 200 pieces, quoted at £7.73–£13.92 FOB per piece.

For wholesale volumes, we pack in double-wall cartons with moulded pulp inserts, marked FRAGILE and drop-tested to ISTA 1A, to cut transit breakage. We also QC-test doors and latches before packing.

Could I send you our catalogue and spec sheet, or arrange samples for evaluation?

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Company]
Moradabad
